description: This Java source file defines a servlet class UspsMockApiServlet that simulates USPS Webtools API responses, primarily for testing purposes. It processes HTTP requests, especially the 'Rate' API, parses XML input, and generates XML responses mimicking USPS rate responses.

classes.name: UspsMockApiServlet
classes.description: A servlet class that mocks USPS Rate API responses for testing purposes.

methods.name: doPost
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST requests, delegates to doGet method.

methods.name: doGet
methods.description: Processes HTTP GET requests to simulate USPS API, generates XML responses based on request parameters.
